title: DirCrumb
description: Durable architectural metadata manifest for a codebase directory.

name.description: Human-readable identifier for the module or directory.

layer.description: Architectural layer identifier (e.g. core/runtime, ui/web, infra/db).

purpose.description: Concise summary of directory responsibilities and scope.

above.description: Pointer to parent architectural domain or repository root.

below.description: List of notable child components and their roles.

invariants.description: Non-negotiable architectural rules enforced within this directory.

exports.description: Key public functions, crates, modules, or services provided.
